mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, overcast clouds. Next 24 hours: high 16, low 8.

Iran's Revolutionary Guard announced it has removed the 2,000-kilometre limit on the range of its ballistic missiles, extending their reach beyond previous self-imposed restrictions.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that in Abu Dhabi talks the parties discussed a large-scale prisoner exchange, proposing swaps of 1,000 for 1,000 or 1,500 for 1,500 detainees.

Former President Donald Trump has nominated Florida businessman Mikhail Bogachek to serve as the United States ambassador to Kosovo.

A 39-year-old Albanian man identified only by the initials L.B. was shot multiple times and left dead near Playa Flamenca in Orihuela Costa, Spain, after fleeing the scene on an electric scooter.

The Swiss city of Lucerne plans to allow 14-year-old residents to submit petitions and concerns to the cantonal parliament, expanding youth participation ahead of the November 29 vote.
